observation.visible_scene: A static view across a green lawn onto a quiet residential street. On the left is a two-story house with a white garage door and a covered front entry reached by steps; a paved road runs horizontally across the middle with a round manhole cover; on the right a large tree trunk and the rear of a parked dark SUV occupy the foreground, with a neighboring house and white vans in the background. The framing and background positions stay constant, indicating no camera motion.
visible_changes: A person is present on the front steps/porch of the house from frame 4 onward, remaining in essentially the same spot near the steps and the round bush for the rest of the sampled segment, with no clear translation.

In a single sampled frame (frame 2) a person walking a brown dog on a leash appears on the road at the right, near the parked SUV; the person and dog are absent in the immediately preceding and following sampled frames.
In a single sampled frame (frame 40) a dark sedan is visible on the road near the center; it is absent in the adjacent sampled frames.
The parked SUV, the white vans, the house, and the tree remain fixed throughout; only minor lighting/shadow variation is seen on the road and grass.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the dog-walker and the sedan actually traversed the scene continuously or whether their one-frame appearances reflect a cut or a sampling gap.
What the porch person does before frame 4 and after the segment ends.
uncertain_details: The porch person's exact posture (standing vs sitting) and whether small frame-to-frame differences are real movement or compression noise.
Whether the single-frame presence of the walker and the sedan represents brief real passes or discontinuities from an editing cut; no smooth entry/exit motion is supported by the samples.
